fields.description: ASCII 'OnePiece' magic header at start of flash image; verified byte-exact in baseline.sav
fields.evidence: ASCII bytes 4F 6E 65 50 69 65 63 65 at save offset 0x00 verified byte-exact in samples/baseline.sav; image bulk transfer uses the CpuFastSet primitive FUN_0804f5b4 (SWI 0x0C fast memory copy).
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: First 1KB half of the encrypted save image (offset 8 through end of first 0x400-byte half); high-entropy ciphertext, no repeating-key XOR or ECB block structure
fields.evidence: High-entropy region (7.0-7.5 bits/byte, flat histogram and autocorrelation) at save offsets 0x08..0x400; bulk-moved via CpuFastSet primitive FUN_0804f5b4 (SWI 0x0C); same 0x400-byte half granularity as the paired 0x100-word copies in FUN_0804d0f4 (there a scene state machine, so the RAM save buffer itself is unlocated in this decomp slice: no 0x0E00xxxx/0x0D00xxxx MMIO and no flash command sequence in decomp/decompiled.c.gz).
fields.name: crypt_image_lo

fields.description: Second (partial) half of the encrypted save image, 0x400 through last non-0xFF byte at 0x795; ciphertext, same properties as first half
fields.evidence: High-entropy region at save offsets 0x400..0x796 ending at the last non-0xFF byte (0x795) per bin_peek of samples/baseline.sav; bulk-moved via CpuFastSet primitive FUN_0804f5b4 (SWI 0x0C); plaintext struct and RAM save buffer live outside this decomp slice (no 0x0E00xxxx save MMIO, no 'OnePiece' constant in decomp/decompiled.c.gz).
fields.name: crypt_image_hi

fields.description: First 16 bytes past the last used image byte; all 0xFF, marking the erase boundary of the flash image
fields.evidence: bin_peek of samples/baseline.sav shows 0x796 as first fully-erased offset (all 0xFF to end of 64KB image), consistent with flash erase state; boundary cross-checked with the CpuFastSet bulk primitive FUN_0804f5b4 transfer granularity (no partial-word tail).
fields.name: erase_sentinel

fields.description: Erased slack from erase sentinel to the end of the first 4KB flash sector (all 0xFF); remaining sectors fully erased, unmapped
fields.evidence: bin_peek of samples/baseline.sav: bytes 0x7A6..0xFFF all 0xFF to the 4KB sector boundary of this 64KB flash512 image; flash erase value 0xFF; image geometry handled with word copies via FUN_0804f5b4 (SWI 0x0C).
fields.name: sector0_slack
